correctness.rationale: Independently derived the exact coordinate matrices J0=[[1,M],[0,beta+(1−beta)M]] for missed row, J1=[[0,M],[-(1−beta),beta+(1−beta)M]] for selected row; their covariance map is the printed 3x3 T. Symbolic SymPy determinant factoring reproduces det(I−T)=π(β−1)[2(1−β)^2 M²+LM+C] with printed L,C. Its quadratic has one positive root and T(0) spectral radius<1 for π in (0,1), beta<1; positivity of the map makes its spectral radius a nonnegative eigenvalue, so no crossing of radius 1 without det=0. Above the root the determinant sign produces a real eigenvalue>1. Starting from (u0≠0,v0=0), the one-step covariance diag(1−π,π(1−β)^2) is positive definite, hence excites every positive-semidefinite Perron direction, proving boundary nondecay and supercritical exponential growth of E[u²]. The u-coordinate of any Perron eigenmatrix must be positive for M>0. Verified βcrit=(5−sqrt17)/2 and β=0,π=1/2,M=.9 gives mean-square radius≈1.20656 while signed H spectral radius=√.9. Finite rational spot tests in source are corroboration only.

value.rationale: The sharp exact stability boundary for every row-norm probability in a natural diagonal benchmark resolves a concrete question posed by the algorithm's source. It diagnoses a physically relevant failure mode hidden by signed means and extends the source's first-moment analysis to a new norm moment; not a routine reparametrization of a known Schur bound.

limitations: Consistency, invertible real diagonal A, row-norm iid selection πj>0, deterministic u0, y0=0, 0≤β<1 and 0≤M≤1 only.
No claim of almost-sure or nonorthogonal general rates.
